Design of a High-Frequency Series Capacitor Buck Converter
00:41:14
|
26 JUL 2016
This training will cover some of the challenges to high frequency operation today, introduce the series capacitor buck converter topology, present some experimental results demonstrating the new topology, and go through the design steps for the series cap buck converter.
Why should I take this training?
Typical buck converters have limitations that prevent small solution sizes
The series capacitor buck converter is a topology alternative that enables higher switching frequencies up to 2 MHz
What will I learn?
Limitations of traditional buck converters at high frequencies
Introduction to the series capacitor buck converter
Design and experimental results of a high-frequency series capacitor buck converter
